List, inspect, and delete images in your per-user image host. Upload with `pura push <image>`.

Usage:
  pura image [command]

Available Commands:
  get         Show an image's URL and metadata
  ls          List your image library
  rm          Delete an image from your library

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for image

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Override API endpoint
      --handle string    User handle (accepts alice or @alice; defaults to _)
      --jq string        Filter JSON output with jq expression
      --json             Force JSON output
      --profile string   Use named profile
      --quiet            Raw data only (no envelope)
      --token string     Override stored token
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output

Use "pura image [command] --help" for more information about a command.
